This is a root-cause cross-column break, not a symptom of another defect: all per-column profiles for amount, quantity, and unit_price are normal. amount is still float with 2 decimal places on all 200 rows, 0 nulls, no duplicate rows, and its marginal distribution is still entirely consistent with being a set of quantity*unit_price products (today's min 10.39 = 1 x min unit_price 10.39; max 7671.69 < 9 x 897.57; mean 2163.6 ~= mean(qty) 4.935 x mean(price) 444.9). quantity and unit_price distributions are unchanged.
